meta_description: Meet Archilance LLC — an architecture outsourcing studio of 48 architects, drafters and visualisers, founded by Asad Kamal Abbasi and Faran Shahbaz Khan.

story: Archilance LLC was co-founded by Asad Kamal Abbasi and Faran Shahbaz Khan, who met the same problem from opposite ends of the industry: good practices turning down good work because the drawing capacity was not there, and good architects sitting idle between projects.

They built the studio they wanted to hire — a full architecture team on a flat monthly subscription, merging their top-tier expertise from a 5-star rated Upwork agency into a company built for global expansion and client-focused delivery.

Today that team is 48 architects, drafters, BIM specialists and visualisers across two offices, working inside our clients' own templates and standards so the output arrives looking like they drew it themselves.

title: Privacy Policy
lede: How Archilance LLC collects, uses and protects your information.
meta_description: Archilance LLC's privacy policy — what information we collect, how we use and disclose it, and your privacy rights.

content.body:
Effective Date: August 01, 2024

Archilance LLC ("we," "our," "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website, use our services, or engage with us.

1. Information We Collect

We may collect information about you in a variety of ways. The information we may collect on the website includes:

  • Personal Data: Personally identifiable information, such as your name, email address, phone number, company name, job title, and project details, that you voluntarily give to us when you fill out forms, register on the website, or communicate with us.
  • Usage Data: Information about your interaction with our website, such as your IP address, browser type, operating system, access times, and pages viewed.

2. Use of Your Information

We use the information we collect to:

  • Provide, operate, and maintain our services.
  • Improve, personalize, and expand our services.
  • Communicate with you, including responding to your inquiries and providing customer support.
  • Send you marketing and promotional materials if you have agreed to receive them.
  • Process transactions and send you related information.
  • Analyze and understand how our services are used.

3. Disclosure of Your Information

We may share information we have collected about you in certain situations:

  • With Your Consent: We may disclose your personal information with your consent.
  • Service Providers: We may share your information with third-party vendors, service providers, contractors, or agents who perform services for us or on our behalf.
  • Legal Requirements: We may disclose your information if required to do so by law or in response to valid requests by public authorities.

4. Data Security

We use administrative, technical, and physical security measures to help protect your personal information. While we have taken reasonable steps to secure the personal information you provide to us, please be aware that despite our efforts, no security measures are perfect or impenetrable, and no method of data transmission can be guaranteed against any interception or other types of misuse.

5. Your Privacy Rights

Depending on your location, you may have the following rights regarding your personal information:

  • The right to access – You have the right to request copies of your personal data.
  • The right to rectification – You have the right to request that we correct any information you believe is inaccurate.
  • The right to erasure – You have the right to request that we erase your personal data, under certain conditions.
  • The right to restrict processing – You have the right to request that we restrict the processing of your personal data, under certain conditions.
  • The right to object to processing.

If you have questions about this policy, contact us using the details on our contact page.

title: Careers at Archilance LLC
lede: We're a remote-first studio working with architects, designers and clients across the world — if you're looking to grow inside real projects, this is where to start.
meta_description: Join Archilance LLC — a remote-first architecture outsourcing studio. Explore open roles and internship opportunities working on real international projects.

content.body:
Great people are the foundation of great work. At Archilance LLC, we look for architects, designers and emerging talent who want to grow inside real projects, not just produce drawings in isolation — working alongside an international team, with the support and mentorship that comes from a studio built around learning and development, not just output.

What working here looks like

  • A genuinely remote, flexible working environment — not a hybrid policy stretched to cover remote work as an afterthought.
  • Direct collaboration with an international team spanning multiple time zones and design traditions.
  • Real project exposure from early on, not a long runway of busywork before you touch anything that matters.
  • A learning-focused culture, with room to develop technical and design skills alongside the work itself.

Open opportunities

Remote BIM & Revit Internship Program

An ongoing internship for architecture students and recent graduates looking to build real, production-grade Revit and BIM experience on live projects, working directly alongside our production team.

Apply now

Don't see an open role that fits?

We're always open to hearing from strong candidates even outside a specific listing. Reach out through our contact page and tell us what you're looking for.
